newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE -- Laguna Salada Union SD, Calif..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE -- Laguna Salada Union SD, Calif..

text.p: (County of San Mateo, State of California)
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the above Bonds will be offered for public sale as capital appreciation bonds by the Board of Supervisors of the County of San Mateo, State of California, on
at the hour of 9:30 A.M., California time (or on such other date and time as may be determined by the County as provided in the paragraph below), at the offices of Kelling,
Northcross & Nobriga, Inc., 1333 Broadway, Suite 1000, Oakland, CA 94612, subject to all of the terms and

conditions of the Official Notice of Sale describing the Bonds, copies of which (along with a Preliminary Official Statement relating to the Bonds) will be furnished upon request to the District's financial advisor, Kelling,
Northcross & Nobriga, Inc., at the above address (telephone (510) 839-8200, fax (510) 208-8282). Legal Opinion: Orrick, Herrington & Sutcliffe LLP.

Any sale date for the Bonds may be changed at the sole discretion of the County by providing notice thereof through Thompson Municipal News and Bloomberg Business News at least twenty-four (24) hours prior to the then-scheduled sale date of the Bonds.
Clerk of the Board of Supervisors
of the County of San Mateo, California
